items.title: Research Operations Lead, Biology
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the team Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a world-class research group focused on making fundamental biological discoveries. The team combines cutting-edge AI with hands-on biological research, positioning Anthropic at the forefront of AI-accelerated scientific discovery. About the role We are hiring a Research Operations Lead to be the operational backbone of our team: the person who makes sure scientists can walk in every morning and get straight to science. You'll take on the operational systems we've started — procurement, inventory, safety, equipment, space — make them better, and scale them as the lab and its needs grow. We're hiring for trajectory as much as for what you've already done: the scope of this role will grow with the size of the team, and we want someone who's excited by that. This role is a rare opportunity to build the operational foundation of Anthropic's biology team and to grow with it. The systems you put in place will shape how a frontier AI company does experimental biology for years to come. If you're energized by high-ownership operational work in the service of ambitious science, we'd love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Own day-to-day operations end to end: ordering and inventory, equipment scheduling and upkeep, consumables, shipping and receiving, and general space organization Build on and extend the operational systems a growing group needs: procurement workflows, inventory and sample tracking, equipment maintenance and calibration schedules, onboarding and training, SOPs Manage facilities and space: coordinate buildouts, moves, and equipment installs; act as the primary interface to building management, contractors, and Anthropic's central Workplace and IT teams Own the operating budget: track spend against plan, run the capital equipment purchasing process, and partner with Finance on forecasting and reporting Manage vendor and supplier relationships: including contract research organizations: source and qualify vendors, negotiate quotes and service contracts, schedule preventive maintenance and field-service visits, and hold suppliers to their commitments Minimum qualifications Have managed the day-to-day operations of a life sciences lab — equipment, inventory, ordering, safety, space, and scheduling Have hands-on procurement and vendor management experience: sourcing suppliers, negotiating quotes and service contracts, and coordinating field-service and maintenance technicians Have tracked and managed an operating budget: purchase orders, invoices, spend-vs-plan, and capital requests Preferred qualifications Are the person everyone in your group already comes to when something is broken, missing, late, or unclear — and you like being that person Enjoy engaging with scientists on the science itself — you want to understand what's happening at the bench well enough to anticipate needs Are results-oriented and practical and pick up slack even when it goes outside your job description Enjoy a role that stretches from the hands-on to the strategic, and are comfortable when priorities shift quickly and feedback is direct Lab operations or lab management experience in a biotech, pharma, diagnostics, or life-sciences startup environment, including exposure to how those organizations build new functions and processes end to end A degree in the life sciences and prior research experience at the bench People-management experience: hiring, onboarding, and supervising operations or facilities staff Experience supporting a team through significant growth in headcount, footprint, or capability, including utilities, permitting, and equipment Familiarity with liquid-handling platforms, including their service, calibration, and consumable needs Experience selecting and administering inventory management, sample tracking, equipment scheduling, or ELN systems Capital equipment lifecycle management experience — evaluation, purchase, qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), service contracts, and decommissioning Experience with regulated shipping and receiving of biological materials, including import/export, permits, and material transfer agreements Experience using AI tools for efficient team and process management (e.g., Claude Cowork) The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $210,000 — $260,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Customer Support Specialist ll, you'll join the Customer Experience team and help deliver fast, empathetic, and knowledgeable support to Coinbase customers around the world. This team is critical to how customers experience Coinbase every day, handling complex inquiries across phone, messaging, and email. You'll own frontline issue resolution, investigate root causes, and ensure every customer interaction builds trust in our platform. What you'll do: Own end-to-end resolution of customer inquiries across phone, messaging, and email channels by investigating, troubleshooting, and solving issues on first contact. Drive accurate issue tracking and defect logging to surface systemic problems and inform upstream product and process improvements. Educate customers proactively on Coinbase products and features, setting clear expectations and adding value in every interaction. Partner with cross-functional teams to escalate, resolve, and close out complex cases that require coordination beyond frontline support. Lead by example within the Customer Support organization by consistently meeting or exceeding performance benchmarks and quality standards. Required Skills and Experience: 2+ years of experience in customer support within financial services, crypto, fintech, or a technology platform, including multi-channel support (phone, messaging, and email). Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve complex customer issues independently, with a track record of high first-contact resolution rates. Proficiency in support tooling such as Salesforce Service Cloud, JIRA, Amazon Connect, or similar CRM and ticketing platforms. Fluency in written and spoken English with the ability to communicate clearly across global teams and diverse customer populations. Willingness to work rotating shifts, weekends, and holidays from the Manila, Philippines office. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. About the Role This role is designed as a launchpad for future sellers at OpenAI. This is a highly strategic role with significant exposure to enterprise sales, product, and customer strategy. items.title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
items.location_text: Paris, Amsterdam, Linz, Munich, London, Berlin
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE JOB Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering. You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases. This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making. You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics. Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost. - Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools. - Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs. - Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation. - Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations. - Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior. - Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation. ABOUT YOU - You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows. - You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field. - You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics. - You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability. - You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition. - You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation. - You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster. - You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans. - You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders. IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU - Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems. - Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows. - Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers. - Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Trust Strategy & Operations
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As part of the trust team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline trust workflows, enhance decision-making around risk, and support responsible growth. The team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners — including Product, Operations, Legal, Marketing, and Engineering — to drive accountability, insights, and operational integrity across the business. In this role, you will be responsible for: - End-to-End Process Management — Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support trust and safety functions, promoting consistency and adoption across the org. - Cross-Functional Collaboration — Partner with Engineering and Growth teams to drive initiatives that enhance trust infrastructure and operational effectiveness. - Leadership Partnership — Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership, delivering strategic insights, risk reporting, and actionable recommendations. - Data-Driven Strategy — Oversee analytics across trust functions. Identify risk patterns and areas for improvement; build dashboards and insights that inform policy decisions and guide operational improvements. - Reporting & Analytics — Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and KPIs that measure trust and safety performance and impact. WHO YOU ARE - Passionate about responsible AI and motivated by building systems that protect users and maintain platform integrity - Highly motivated with a strong work ethic — you understand the stakes of this moment in AI and are committed to getting it right - Analytical and first-principles oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex risk tradeoffs - Consistently deliver high-quality work quickly and take initiative from day one - Low ego, high ownership REQUIREMENTS - Excellent communication skills and ability to translate complex risk data into clear recommendations - 4+ years in Security, Trust & Safety Operations, or Risk Operations at a high-growth technology company - Proven track record building end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis through to execution - Experience working cross-functionally with Policy, Legal, or Safety teams - Highly adaptable with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe. Preference for candidates based in London. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Paid Social Specialist - UK&I
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a Paid Social Specialist to join our UK&I Media team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing Paid Social marketing campaigns across multiple brands. You will play an important role in executing new campaigns and the wider strategy to grow the channel within our local structure for the UK & Ireland. You will be reporting directly to the Paid Social & Programmatic Lead, while working closely with other stakeholders in the UK&I Media team and across the wider UK&I cluster, including Marketing, Brand, Creative, AdTech teams and more. In order to drive successful campaigns, you will utilise all the latest solutions and tools from Paid Social platforms (including Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok, Reddit and similar). To succeed in this role, you need to be a self-driven and self-motivated individual - ready to work hands-on across multiple accounts. You will actively manage and optimise campaigns, whilst working closely with the team and expanding your digital marketing experience. The ideal candidate will be a positive and adaptable team player, with a problem-solving attitude, and good communication and presentation skills. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Executing and managing a wide range of Paid Social campaigns hands-on across multiple platforms (including Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok, Reddit and similar), for all verticals (casino, live casino, sports betting) and multiple brands. - Working closely with the team to analyse metrics from internal tools and platforms to track campaign performance and continuously optimise our accounts. - Implementing new channel solutions and running regular A/B tests across our activity, aligned with the overall goals and KPIs. - Building active collaboration with our key partners across external digital platform teams and tech vendors. - Navigating complex tracking and attribution systems with the Media team and AdTech teams to maximise our measurement capabilities across the channel and expand our incrementality testing. - Collaborating with Brand and Creative teams to ensure messaging and creatives are aligned across the funnel and utilise channel best practices. - Activating CRM data within our platforms to execute highly targeted segmentation strategies as well as drive lookalike modelling. - Staying ahead of platform updates, new ad formats, and emerging media opportunities. - Working closely with the Central Marketing teams to ensure alignment, consistency and best practice sharing across markets. - Ensuring full compliance with regional advertising regulations and other compliance standards. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: - 1-2 years of experience in Paid Social or wider digital marketing role (client side or agency). Gaming industry experience will be considered a plus. - Hands-on experience working with some of the popular social media platforms (Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok and/or Reddit). - Basic knowledge of Paid Social best practices - from a technical perspective, through performance delivery, to creative guidelines and tools. - Strong analytical mindset, confident in spotting opportunities for growth. Professional experience in using analytics tools will be considered a plus (Tableau/Looker, Google Analytics, Appsflyer or similar). - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. - Fluent English is essential for this role, both written and spoken. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid working - 3 days per week at the office, with flexibility for 2 days at home - Workation – Take your job on an adventure with our Workation benefit for up to 4 weeks per year (T&Cs apply). - Plenty of time to recharge – 28 days of paid leave, plus all public and bank holidays in England. - Invest in your future – We match pension contributions up to 6%. - Comprehensive healthcare – BUPA coverage, including pre-existing conditions, plus a cashback plan for dental, optical, and other treatments. - Wellbeing allowance – £250 annual allowance for you to invest in your health and wellbeing (T&Cs apply). - A great workplace experience – Talented colleagues, free onsite parking, complimentary snacks and drinks, Monday breakfasts, and Friday lunches. - A social culture you’ll love – Regular opportunities to attend sporting events throughout the year, plus a quarterly team budget for even more fun. - Support for growing families – Up to 6 months of full pay for maternity leave. - Stay active & save money – Cycle-to-work scheme and gym discounts. - And there’s more… We’ll share even more perks related to your role when you chat with our Talent Acquisition team! JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Customer Success Manager, Beneficial Deployments EMEA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Join Anthropic as an EMEA-based Customer Success Manager supporting our Beneficial Deployments team's work with nonprofits. You'll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to mission-driven organizations across EMEA, spanning a range of impact areas. Your focus is driving activation, adoption, and value of Claude across Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and the API. That means helping these organizations evolve how they work internally, and guiding them as they evolve how they serve their missions and constituents with AI. You'll work as a pod with your Account Executive and Applied AI counterpart. Within the pod, you'll decide what level of engagement each customer most needs and either personally deliver it or connect the customer to resources that serve their needs. CS-led engagements range from high-touch 1:1 partnerships to one-to-many cohort engagements, with the latitude to design other approaches where they serve customers better. As one of our early Customer Success Managers in EMEA, you'll be a pioneer: helping to build regional processes, establish new customer relationships, and represent Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while staying closely aligned with global teams, which calls for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and works effectively across time zones. The insights you gather from these partnerships will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and strategies for beneficial AI deployment. As the voice of the customer, you'll help shape how we build and deliver AI systems that amplify social good. Key responsibilities Work as a pod with your Account Executive and Applied AI counterpart, building shared territory and success plans Drive activation and adoption across your portfolio, using your judgment to match the engagement model to what each customer most needs Use your knowledge of each customer and of regional nuances to plan usage proactively, understanding current and future consumption and adoption and how they create realized value for the customer Build trusting relationships with nonprofit leaders, program teams, and IT staff to understand their mission, goals, and capacity Guide customers in evolving how they work internally, with change management suited to mission-driven cultures, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and enablement that respects capacity constraints Help customers evolve how they serve their missions and constituents with AI, identifying high-impact use cases across program delivery, research, fundraising, and operations Become an expert in Anthropic's products across the API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, guiding customers to the right solutions and keeping them current on what's new Document and quantify value realized through social impact outcomes, program effectiveness, cost savings, and mission amplification, and share it in regular impact reviews that build the case for continued investment Build the repeatable playbooks, enablement resources, and regional processes that scale across the EMEA portfolio, and bring customer insights back to Product and Research You may be a good fit if you have 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architecture, or similar), ideally supporting mission-driven organizations such as nonprofits, foundations, educational institutions, or government agencies Experience working as part of an account team alongside sales and technical counterparts Experience managing high-touch strategic accounts and designing one-to-many programs (cohorts, webinars, user communities, or similar), with the judgment to know which a customer needs A track record of driving activation and adoption of new technology, including change management in organizations with limited technical capacity Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models Technical fluency with AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns, and the ability to explain them to audiences from frontline staff to executive leadership A strategic mindset to identify opportunities for expanded social impact and turn them into actionable plans Comfort operating with significant autonomy in an early-stage regional team, and working effectively with global colleagues across time zones Passion for both AI and social impact work, with strong interest in ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely, ethically, and deployed to benefit society A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality (Bonus) Fluency in French, German, Spanish, or Italian The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £125,000 — £165,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. We’re looking for a Social & Marketing Coordinator to turn internet culture into measurable growth at Easygo - a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. You’ll spot what’s about to break through across streaming, crypto and social, then run the partner relationships and social PR that turn it into results. It’s hands-on, fast-moving work, often from idea to shipped in the same day. What you’ll build with us: You’ll keep our clipping ecosystem sharp, from the CPM-based clipping and UGC creator networks to the trackers, payout files and creator lists that keep them running. You’ll also pitch and place content with large social pages and press outlets, and coordinate campaign moments around signings, collaborations and brand partnerships. You’ll work with creators, pages, outlets and internal teams, reporting to the Partnerships Manager in Marketing. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Spot and act on trends across Kick, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, X, TikTok, Discord and crypto and streaming communities, and turn those observations into campaign ideas quickly. Run social PR by pitching and placing content with large social pages and press outlets, and coordinate campaign moments around signings, collaborations and brand partnerships. Oversee our CPM-based clipping and UGC creator networks, monitoring spend and performance and keeping tracking sheets and payout data accurate. Own the operational details, including payout files, creator lists, campaign trackers and approval statuses, so work moves forward without gaps. Take ambiguous requests from idea to shipped outcome, coordinating creators, pages, outlets and internal teams. Your track record: A genuine interest in streaming, crypto and internet culture, with a strong sense of what audiences will notice and share. Strong marketing instincts and the ability to explain why an idea will land with a specific audience. High attention to detail and confidence owning spreadsheets, trackers, reporting and data hygiene alongside creative campaigns. Familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets and basic campaign tracking and reporting tools. The ability to manage multiple relationships across creators, social pages, media outlets and internal teams at the same time. A proactive, self-directed approach with a bias toward action, and the confidence to turn ambiguous requests into clear next steps and completed work. Organisation and dependability when several fast-moving priorities compete for attention. Commercial awareness and an audience focus, balancing creative judgement with performance data. Clear, confident communication with external partners and internal stakeholders. Bonus points if you also have: Experience with Discord communities, clipping or UGC networks, or CPM-based creator programs. Experience in streaming, gaming, crypto, betting or an adjacent industry. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Service Designer, Intelligence & Investigations
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Intelligence and Investigations (I2) team provides intelligence to decision makers across OpenAI and investigates severe misuse of our products. I2’s work saves lives: we disrupt real-world violence, protect children, and prevent catastrophic harms from AI misuse. We draw on our investigations and in-depth analysis of a wide range of data sources to provide actionable quantitative and qualitative intelligence to OpenAI’s leadership. Our analysts and investigators make sense of complex data to understand emerging risks and investigate severe misuse. They work closely with engineers who build tools that extend what human experts can see and do. The design of the investigative workflow shapes how effectively people can use those tools and act on what they learn. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a service designer to shape how investigative cases move through OpenAI, from the first signal through review and action. You’ll work alongside investigators to understand what each case requires and how the overall workflow shapes what investigators can accomplish. You’ll bring that perspective to the people who shape investigative operations and the engineers who build the underlying systems. Together, you’ll decide where a change would help and see how it works in real cases. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Work alongside investigators to understand how cases move across teams and systems. Consider what that process means for people at risk, people whose activity is under review, and the people responsible for acting on a finding. - Combine what you learn from individual cases with operational data to decide where a change would help most and whether it calls for a change in the workflow, the tools, or both. - Lead the cross-team work of mapping investigative workflows, designing improvements with the people who use and operate them, and putting agreed changes into practice. - Guide engineering decisions about how investigative systems fit together to support the overall workflow. - Follow changes into use. Look for whether they help investigators act in time, make well-supported decisions, and sustain demanding work. WE'RE SEEKING SOMEONE WITH EXPERIENCE INCLUDING: - 8+ years of relevant experience in service design or closely related roles, with demonstrated ownership of improvements to complex operational workflows from research through implementation and evaluation. - A bachelor’s degree in Service Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Human Factors, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - Strong qualitative research and synthesis skills, with the ability to combine insights from investigators and analysts with operational data to identify bottlenecks, inform priorities, and improve decision-making. - Experience designing across internal tools, SME workflows, and systems, including how information, evidence, and decisions move between teams. - Proven experience leading ambiguous projects across product, engineering, operations, and policy teams, translating evolving risks and needs into practical solutions. - Experience using AI tools to support research synthesis, explore service design options, and prototype workflows, with sound judgment about sensitive information, output validation, and decisions that require human review. - Clear written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to make complex workflows understandable, explain design decisions, navigate tradeoffs, and build alignment across technical and operational teams. - A hands-on approach and the persistence to follow improvements through rollout, adoption, and evaluation, measuring their effect on investigation quality, timeliness, and team effectiveness. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have experience designing services around the needs of the people who use and run them. - Enjoy learning how specialists work. You can draw on their different perspectives to understand a service that no single team sees in full. - Have worked with operational and engineering teams to put a service design into practice. You’re comfortable discussing how a technical choice in one part of a workflow affects people elsewhere. - Care about what happens after a design goes into use. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Deputy MLRO on the Institutional AML/CTF Compliance team, you'll execute anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing programs across Coinbase's international entities, including Coinbase Bermuda Services Limited, Coinbase Bermuda Limited, Coinbase Custody International, and the CBIE Trust. This team protects Coinbase's customers and licenses by maintaining robust AML/CTF controls, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting across multiple jurisdictions. You'll act with delegated authority from the Chief Compliance Officer and MLRO, leading day-to-day compliance operations including suspicious transaction reporting, customer due diligence reviews, governance reporting, and regulatory correspondence across Ireland and Bermuda. What you'll do: Lead day-to-day AML/CTF compliance operations with delegated authority from the Chief Compliance Officer and MLRO, including transaction monitoring, alert review, and escalation of suspicious activity across all covered entities. Drive the development, preparation, and presentation of materials for required AML Compliance Governance Committee meetings, ensuring leadership has clear visibility into program health and risk. Prepare and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings for assigned entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission to the relevant authorities in each jurisdiction. Conduct customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews, assessing customer risk profiles and escalating complex or high-risk cases as appropriate. Monitor regulatory developments across Ireland and Bermuda, flagging relevant changes to the MLRO and contributing to policy and procedure updates. Partner with internal teams including CX, Legal, and Operations to ensure consistency in compliance processes and support responses to regulatory inquiries or examinations. Required Skills and Experience: 6+ years of experience in AML/CTF compliance, financial crimes, or a related compliance function within financial services, fintech, or a regulated entity, with experience operating in a Deputy MLRO or senior compliance role with delegated authority. Working knowledge of AML/CTF legislation in Ireland and/or Bermuda, including the Criminal Justice (Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing) Act 2010 (as amended), CBI guidance, EU Anti-Money Laundering Directives, and/or the Bermuda Proceeds of Crime Act and Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) requirements. Demonstrated experience conducting customer due diligence (CDD/EDD) reviews, transaction monitoring, and preparing suspicious transaction reports or equivalent regulatory filings across multiple entities or jurisdictions. Proven ability to contribute to compliance governance processes, including preparing reporting and materials for governance committees and senior leadership. items.title: Senior Product Designer - Sports F/M
items.description: 📍 Hybrid work model: Our Product Design team is based in Bordeaux, but we hire across Europe. Minimum 4 days per month in our Bordeaux office. WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here's why you'll love working with us: 💡 An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈 Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡 A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us 🌟 A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME 🎮 As a Senior Product Designer , you will join Betclic's Product Design team, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, User Researchers and Content Designers to help millions of players discover relevant sports, events and betting opportunities. Betclic is mobile-first, operating in a fast-moving, real-time entertainment environment. You will transform complex sports betting journeys into intuitive, personalized and engaging experiences that make discovering sports, events and betting opportunities intuitive, relevant and engaging. Beyond improving existing features, you will help shape the future of trusted sports entertainment through strong UX fundamentals, player psychology, thoughtful interaction design and Responsible Motivation. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 In this role, your main missions will be: 🏟️ SPORTS PRODUCT SQUAD The squad helps players discover relevant sports, competitions and betting opportunities across Betclic's extensive catalogue. Key challenges include: Discovery and navigation : making large amounts of sports content easy to explore and understand. Personalization : translating recommendations and player preferences into relevant, trustworthy experiences. Real-time complexity : designing clear interactions for live events, changing odds and complex betting markets. Evidence-driven improvement : using player insights and product data to identify opportunities and improve experiences. WHAT YOU WILL DO 🚀 In your squad, you will: Lead complex design challenges end to end , from framing player problems and exploring alternatives to validating solutions, preparing implementation-ready designs and learning from results. Design intuitive and engaging mobile-first experiences that simplify complex sports content, navigation, personalization and real-time betting journeys. Make informed design decisions , using player insights, product data and critical thinking to challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs and balance player value, business goals, technical constraints and regulatory requirements. Explore and validate meaningful alternatives , using workshops, research, experimentation and interactive prototypes to test important assumptions before committing to a solution. Apply strong UX/UI and emotional design craft to create clear, accessible and engaging experiences that encourage participation responsibly – without misleading players or compromising their understanding and control. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, User Research and other CXP disciplines , contributing throughout Discovery, Delivery and post-launch learning. Use AI-assisted design tools responsibly to accelerate exploration, prototyping, iteration and validation while maintaining human judgment and quality standards. Raise design quality beyond your own work , providing constructive feedback, mentoring less-experienced designers and contributing to shared UX patterns and Design System improvements. Measure and improve experience outcomes , working with Product, Data and User Research to define success criteria, evaluate results and turn learning into future improvements. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Your impact goes beyond delivering high-quality designs. You help the team make better product decisions, simplify complex player journeys and create engaging, trustworthy experiences that improve player outcomes. You independently lead complex initiatives, contribute to shared design standards and help other designers grow. Your success is reflected in improved player experiences, better-informed product decisions, stronger design quality and the positive influence you have on other designers and shared design practices. HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI 🤖 AI is becoming a core part of modern Product Design. At Betclic, we use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate research support, ideation, prototyping, iteration and validation while keeping human judgment, creativity and accountability at the center. You don't need to master every AI tool, but we expect curiosity, practical experimentation and the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated work, including its limitations and risks. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! This job is for you if: You have substantial experience designing complex digital consumer products , with demonstrated impact and the ability to independently lead design work from discovery through delivery. You have strong UX/UI fundamentals , including information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, usability, accessibility, and mobile-first design. You enjoy solving complex product challenges , such as personalization, large content catalogues, real-time information, and sophisticated user journeys. You demonstrate professional judgment , using evidence, critical thinking, and clear reasoning to challenge assumptions, explain decisions and balance competing requirements. You are comfortable exploring alternatives, prototyping and validating ideas before converging on a solution. You collaborate effectively with Product Managers, Engineers, User Researchers, and other designers , and can constructively influence decisions. You have high standards for design quality and enjoy mentoring others, sharing knowledge and improving reusable design patterns. You have a genuine interest in sports and digital entertainment . Previous betting experience is valuable but not essential. You are curious about AI-assisted design and willing to experiment with new tools and ways of working. You can work professionally in English; French is a plus. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 If your application is shortlisted, our recruiter will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). About two weeks later, you will either take a technical test with one of our design experts or work on a case study to present to the team. Next, you will meet your future manager, followed by a member of the Executive or Management Committee. Finally, the recruiter will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. items.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Large Molecules, Process Development)
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist with deep expertise in antibody process development and manufacturing to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be an expert in making antibodies, with hands-on experience expressing, purifying, characterizing, and formulating them, from small screening batches to material for IND-enabling studies. Above all, you'll close the loop between AI-generated hypotheses and experimental data to share with the community. Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you'll build and run the workflows that turn AI-designed sequences into well-characterized protein, and pressure-test AI predictions of expression, stability, and manufacturability against real data. This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area. Key responsibilities Develop and run expression and purification processes for antibodies and other recombinant proteins end to end, including transient and stable expression in mammalian cells (HEK293, CHO), affinity capture (Protein A, IMAC), polishing chromatography, buffer exchange, and formulation Characterize what we make with the right analytical panel, for example SEC, CE-SDS, icIEF, LC-MS (intact mass, peptide mapping, glycans), DLS, thermal stability, endotoxin, and binding kinetics (SPR, BLI) Build the laboratory for this work, including selecting, installing, and qualifying equipment and setting up workflows that scale from plate-based production of hundreds of designs to gram quantities of a lead Evaluate AI-designed antibodies for manufacturability (titer, aggregation, stability under stress, viscosity, chemical liabilities), drive them to experimental readout, and feed results back to research teams Plan the chemistry, manufacturing, and controls (CMC) path toward IND-enabling studies, from cell line development and scale-up to analytical methods and stability, and coordinate technology transfer and manufacturing with external contract manufacturers Ensure experimental data across programs is high quality and well documented, including batch records, methods, raw data, and failure modes Communicate findings clearly to biology, AI research, and life sciences audiences Minimum qualifications PhD in biochemical engineering, chemical engineering, biochemistry, or a related field Demonstrated experience in process development and manufacturing of antibodies or other recombinant proteins, including material supplied for IND-enabling or clinical studies, with recent, sustained hands-on laboratory work Comfort navigating ambiguity and defining problems in a rapidly evolving research environment Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills Preferred qualifications 5+ years of biologics process development experience beyond the PhD Depth in both upstream (cell line development, bioreactors) and downstream (chromatography, filtration) development, with working knowledge of analytical and formulation development Experience setting up a protein production or process development laboratory, including laboratory automation and high-throughput, plate-based expression and purification Experience directing technology transfer and GMP manufacturing at contract development and manufacturing organizations, with contributions to the CMC sections of an IND Statistics or coding skills, for example design of experiments or Python for data analysis and automation Experience using AI or ML tools in the life sciences Publications and/or patents demonstrating scientific impact The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.location_text: New York, Austin, San Francisco, Canada, Seattle, United States, Los Angeles, Toronto
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? We are hiring for this role on a full-time contract basis to provide paternity leave coverage through the end of June 2027. Cohere is in a unique and exciting position to grow our go-to-market teams globally! We are hiring for this role on a full-time contract basis to provide paternity leave coverage through the end of June 2027. We are looking for creative, high-performing talent partners who are eager to take on a new challenge as we are in the early stages of building the Talent Acquisition function. In this role, you will master a new domain of recruiting, hire world-class business talent, and influence the scaling of a high-growth Canadian tech company. If you consider yourself resilient, collaborative, influential, and a lifelong learner with an established network, we’d love to hear from you! As a Talent Partner, you will: - Build, own, and nurture a strong pipeline of world-class business talent across People, Finance, Revenue, Marketing & Communications, and Operations - Deliver a world-class recruiting experience that reflects Cohere's premium brand - Partner with hiring managers and talent partners to find and engage passive talent through creative sourcing methods - Maintain deep market intelligence on business talent trends and competitive landscape - Manage comprehensive recruiting funnels in our ATS, updating progress and analytics regularly - Develop creative, proactive sourcing approaches to optimize the top of the funnel for business roles - Cultivate relationships with established networks across business communities and industry leaders - Identify and own additional high-impact talent projects as they emerge Who you are: - You have 5+ years of experience recruiting for business roles across Sales, Finance, Revenue, Marketing & Communications, and Operations in markets like EMEA/US etc. - You have a proven track record of hiring candidates in high-growth and a high-bar environments (startup, technology, AI experience strongly preferred) - You bring an established, high-profile network in business communities - You're a creative problem solver who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments - You're a natural influencer with exceptional relationship-building skills - You leverage data and analytics to drive sourcing decisions and measure effectiveness - You're passionate about diversity, equity, and building inclusive business teams - You have a strategic mindset with the ability to see beyond immediate hiring needs WHY COHERE - Impact: Shape the future of AI talent at a cutting-edge company. - Culture: Collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven. - Growth: Join a team scaling from 800 to 2000+ over 18 months. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: LATAM Public Policy Associate
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Achieving this goal requires deep engagement with policymakers, regulators, institutions, and communities shaping the future of AI. The Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to ensure that external perspectives inform our work and that policy frameworks support the safe and beneficial development of AI. We work closely with research, product, policy, legal, communications, and go-to-market teams to anticipate emerging issues, shape responsible policy outcomes, and advance OpenAI’s mission around the world. About the Role OpenAI is seeking a Latam Public Policy Associate to support its public policy work in Brazil and help coordinate regional initiatives across Latin America. This individual contributor role reports to Nicolas Andrade. Brazil will remain the role’s primary focus, building on ongoing policy research, stakeholder engagement, and program delivery. The role will also provide program management and general support on regional policy issues, working with the Head of LATAM Public Policy and colleagues across OpenAI. Regional assignments will be agreed with Nicolas Andrade. In this role, you will: - Monitor legislative, regulatory, and political developments relevant to OpenAI in Brazil, and prepare concise updates on their implications for the team. - Draft policy research, briefing notes, talking points, presentations, and correspondence for internal discussions and external engagements. - Support Brazil stakeholder engagement with government, regulators, civil society, academia, and industry, including meeting preparation, stakeholder mapping, and follow-up. - Coordinate selected public policy programs and initiatives across Latin America, maintaining workplans, owners, milestones, deadlines, and action items. - Provide research and general support on regional policy questions, consolidating country-team input and preparing comparative summaries and briefing materials. - Support events, roundtables, executive visits, partnerships, and educational initiatives, including logistics, materials, stakeholder coordination, and follow-up. - Work with policy, legal, communications, partnerships, and other relevant teams to obtain input, track reviews, and keep agreed activities on schedule. - Help adapt and review policy and program materials for Brazilian audiences, coordinating with local colleagues on materials for other Latin American markets. - Maintain shared trackers, engagement records, and regular updates on program progress, outcomes, risks, and next steps. You might thrive in this role if you: - Enjoy combining policy research and writing with practical coordination and delivery. - Are organized, attentive to detail, and reliable in following through on commitments. - Work collaboratively across teams and countries, and communicate clearly when priorities or timelines change. - Exercise sound judgment and discretion, know when to seek guidance, and are curious about AI and its implications for the region. We're looking for a blend of: - 6+ years of experience in public policy, government relations, policy research, or a related field, including work on technology or digital policy. - Familiarity with Brazilian institutions and legislative and regulatory processes, and an interest in policy developments across Latin America. - Experience preparing clear research, briefings, and written materials for different audiences. - Experience coordinating projects or programs involving multiple stakeholders, with the ability to manage timelines, track deliverables, and follow up. - Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Spanish proficiency is a plus. - An academic background in political science, public policy, law, international relations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.
